craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of proclamation — the hammer now proclaims: breath demoted → rest unfolds → Māyā named → mother proclaimed → fence → double-held VERDICT. Fence verse: pervasion+linking fenced to I-sharers; end-weight fits-nothing-inert. Rejected: (a) softening fence → killed: fence is content. (b) the inert→inert ones → killed: L3 frozen. Read aloud: WHAT-ev-er GROUNDS thing-ORD-er-ing … FITS-no-thing IN-ert.

lines: Whatever grounds thing-ordering — pervasion and linking
of the I-sharer — fits nothing inert.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhāvavyavasthā yan niṣṭhā tasyāhaṃbhāvabhāginaḥ vyāpitvam anusaṃdhānaṃ taj jaḍasya na yujyate

reads_against.argmap: What fits the inert? → Pervasion and linking belong to I-sharers only: the inert cannot host them.
c1_essence: Breath, body, and the eightfold city are demoted to knowables: no ordering lies in breath, no restraint touches the self, and living-ness stands beyond non-showing (vv19-22).

Rest unfolds into freedom, doership, lordship; Māyā named from power alone; the beginningless mother-principle proclaimed; pervasion fenced to I-sharers; the world verdict that-nondual-made (vv23-27).
